purpose: Unlabelled floor-plan inputs for exploratory ROOMSHIFT testing
notes: Prompts describe intended layouts, not verified ground truth.
No metric scale or geometry annotations are supplied. Choose an explicit assumed measurement when calibrating in the app.
Parser compatibility has not been tested. Image 10 includes an additional entry corridor and a window at a partition junction.

images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: synthetic floor-plan PNG dataset input for ROOMSHIFT room reconstruction.
Primary request: A single empty rectangular room, wider than tall, with one entrance door in the lower wall and one window in the upper wall.
Style: clean flat black-and-white architectural raster drawing on pure white, strictly top-down orthographic 2D, thick solid black straight horizontal and vertical walls, fine door swing arcs and thin parallel window lines in wall gaps. Square canvas with generous white margins; entire plan visible. Walls must connect cleanly at right angles; no diagonal walls. Empty white interiors. No furniture, text, dimension labels, grid, title, scale bars, colors, shading, perspective, watermarks, or page borders. One floor plan only, not a collage.
